en:
If we're gonna play...
We play to win.
Agreed!

Ah, Kiryu-san!
We been waiting fer ya!
It's finally time to take on the Thunders' farm team.
Ahhh, I'm gettin' nervous...!

Hey now.
Let's not get nervous playing 'gainst a farm team.
Moritsuka... You're looking the part.

Yeah well... I think I'd look even
snappier in a major league uniform...
But, I s'pose this suits me fer now.
Show us what you got today, all right?

Yeah, y'won't regret bringin' me aboard.
So... Let's crush 'em.
Well well, greetings, my Warriors friends.
Huh? Why're you here, Hamana?

Whoa, let's not get snotty, now.
I cleared my calendar t'see this dog n' pony show.

I jus' wanted t'burn the look on yer faces
when y'lose to my farm team into my mind.
Ha, always the jackass, Hamana.

Funny hearin' that from a guy drunk
outta his socks 'til yesterday.

You promised, we'll play the real Thunders
once we beat yer farm team today, right?

Yeah, I promised.
But, y'gotta beat 'em first.

Second string or not, they're still Thunders.
And they don't lose to losers.
If y'think y'can beat em, shall we get goin'?
More than happy to!

I'll be watchin' the show from
the dugout. Best o' luck to ya.
We can't lose this one...!
Yeah... Let's humiliate 'em.

Kiryu-san, when yer ready,
just come lemme know.

Let's figure out the batting lineup and
field positions, then start the game!
Kiryu-san! Let's win this one!

Really? You guys lost?
What happened t'all that trash talk earlier, hm?

Damn, guys. I didn't think a team
could even be this bad!

Well, the farm team'll be here if y'ever
want a rematch! Try as many times as y'want!

Maybe you'll even be a little less pathetic
next time...

Kiryu-san... Let's train and gather more players...
Then we can try again.
I won't let it end like this!
We did it!
Yeaaaahhh!

Kiryu-san, we did it!
Our first victory as the reborn Warriors!
Yeah, we did it.

Aw yeah!
I'm crackin' open a cold one tonight!

Amazing... I forgot what it was like t'win...
I guess we're capable if we put in the work.

Thank you, Kiryu-san...
We owe a lot of this win to you!

Baseball is a team sport.
It wasn't just me. We won together, right?

Kiryu-san...! Yes!
We're all winners today!

Dipshits!
How'd ya'll lose to a team this pathetic!?
W-We're sorry...!

Screw it! Y'boys owe me some laps!
Get a move on, right now!
Not too shabby... Setouchi Warriors...!

Don't forget your promise.
The next game is against the real Thunders!

That's fine.
Maybe you'll make a nice warm-up fer us.

Still... Don't expect us t'go down like
these second string rejects.
Thunder... always brings the noise.

Kiryu-san... He's right, the second string
Thunders don't hold a candle to the main team.

We should gather more players, train 'em up,
and get in some practice games before that.
Hey! Chiba-san! Kiryu-san!

Since we got our first victory...
We gotta celebrate with some drinks!

Get a move on! I'm feelin' great,
so it's my treat tonight!
Damn, that's mighty generous!

But the next match'll be tough...
We can't go drinkin'... Right?

Nah, let them celebrate, Chiba.
It's important to remember the taste of victory.

I-Is that so?
Yeah, I guess you're right!

We'll be there soon!
Kiryu-san, let's go!
All right, let's keep up the momentum!

That was a riot.
The team's gettin' fired up.

Whoa, one too many fer me.
But tomorrow we hit the field hard!

We do gotta practice!
I wanna keep winnin'!
All right, I'm gonna take off.

No prob, Kiryu-san!
Thanks for everything!

Our next opponent is the Thunders proper...
They talk so much trash, I wanna beat 'em!

I'll do everything in my power...
So stay with us a while, Kiryu-san.

Nice! I'll see ya on the field then,
Kiryu-san! Later!

Heh, Chiba sounds like he's
floating on air now...

Victory drinks tasted great tonight...
When we beat that punk, they'll be even better.

Kiryu-san... It's finally time for us
t'take on the Thunders' main roster.

Oh, whadda we got here?
If it ain't the Setouchi scrubs.
Think you're really ready t'play us?

Of course! And we'll win this time too,
just like our last game!

Heh, don't count yer chickens just yet.
Whoopin' our farm team means nothin'.

We'll crush you without breakin' a sweat,
just t'show you how out of yer league we are.

Not gonna happen. If y'think we're the same
Warriors as before, y'better think again.

Our team has changed ever since
Captain Kiryu came along!
Right, Kiryu-san!?
Hm? Y-Yeah...

Y'really think bringin' on one amateur
changes the game? We'll see...

We were just lookin' for some boys t'practice
on so we can take down the Legends or the Gorgeous.
Hamana-san, this is that Kiryu guy?
He's our relief ace, Shinozaki.

Craaap!
Shinozaki's here today...?

Kiryu-san, he's a pretty well-known
relief pitcher here in Onomichi.

They swap him in toward the end so he
can put the final nail in the other team's coffin...

That's how he came t'be known as
the "Reaper of Onomichi"...!
The Reaper of Onomichi...
Let's have a good game, eh?

Kiryu-san, if they get a lead and Shinozaki enters
the game, our chances are good as shot!

We need t'score some runs and gain
a good lead early on if we wanna hold it!

Let me know when you're good to go!
Then we'll get the team ready t'play!

Kiryu-san!
Let's win this one!
So strong...

Y'all were tootin' so much hot air, but
now y'see how much yer team just blows.

What happened t'your big shot Captain
Kiryu makin' ya'll stronger, hm?

Well, it was a nice warm-up for us
all the same. Challenge us any time!
As long as y'don't expect different results!

Kiryu-san... Let's train harder, gather more
players, and take them on again.
I'd die of shame if we never beat them!
Yeah... We won't lose again.

Impossible...
How'd we lose to this buncha clowns?

We did it!
We won, Kiryu-san!

We'll never take down the Legends if
we can't even take down the Warriors...
Bravo! Not too shabby.
Hm? Who're you?
Ch-Champ!
Champ...?

Y'don't recognize a former pro ball champion?
He's Champ Shigenaga-san.

Man, I didn't expect the Warriors to win.
That was a great game. Right, Lu-san?

We actually play on an amateur baseball
team called the "Onomichi Legends."

And we've been looking for a team to play,
since the Thunders seem to have gone silent.

Wanna play us sometime?
What do you think, Warriors?

What!? P-Play against the Legends...?
The best team in Onomichi!?

Sure, I mean, you're clearly better than
the Thunders, so what have you got to lose?
Wh-What should we do, Kiryu-san...?
There's no reason to say no.

If anything, we should be honored that such
a skilled team would even challenge us.
Y-You are so right!

That fearless attitude in the
face of adversity...
Hmmm. I like it.
Well, I say we call it a day.

I prefer games when both teams are at their best,
so rest well from trouncing the Thunders.
Let's go, Lu-san.

I-Isn't this exciting, Kiryu-san!? Let's keep this
momentum going and take down the Legends too!

Y'damn boneheads...
Not even we could squeeze a win out 'gainst them...

Defeatin' us don't mean dirt. The Legends are
all former pros in a league of their own...
A-Are they really that good?

Yeah, Shigenaga needs no explanation, but that
Lu guy is a real slugger... Y'better watch him.

In his last game, he was a beast unchained.
In four at-bats, he knocked four outta the park.
F-Four back-to-back...!?

Feh... Consider it a victory if y'don't
have t'forfeit on account of the mercy rule...

I guess even though they're retired,
they'd still be pretty skilled...

Yeah... But, we've been improving little by
little too. We can at least take them on.

Th-That's true...!
Let's show them our Warriors spirit!

Kiryu-san... It's finally time t'play
Onomichi's best team, the Legends.
Hey guys!
Ah, Champ!

Maaan, isn't the weather just great?
It's a perfect day for baseball.

I agree. We're excited t'
play against you guys today!

Let's play fair and square...
fer the title of Onomichi's best!

We're excited to play against
you guys as well, Warriors.

Lu-san, how are you feeling today?
Gonna pound some home today?

Yeah, Shige-san.
I feel like swingin' for the fences.

Ah, that's great to hear. Lookin' forward
to seeing 'em fly over the wall.

Kiryu-san, as long as they've got players like
Champ and Lu-san, we can't expect a shutout.

That said, we need to make this a real
slugfest and play to out bat 'em!
Yeah, good call.

Let me know when you're ready,
and we'll get the team in position!
Kiryu-san! Let's win another today!

Th-They really are pros...
We didn't stand a chance...
Hmm, that's a pity.

I thought the Warriors would have a
little more finesse than that. How disappointing...

Well, don't get too discouraged. We can play
again, and maybe you'll be better next time?
Right on, Shige-san.

Kiryu-san... Let's train the team, build it up,
and take 'em on again!

W-We did it!
We won, Kiryu-san!
We did it! Chiba! Kiryu-san!

Maaan, you guys are tough!
We got stomped.
You guys played just as hard.

No no, don't play the pity card.
You beat us, fair and square...
But remember, Legends never die...!

I can't believe we beat the Legends,
the best team in Onomichi...

Woohoo!
Yeaaahhh, we did it!

The Legends are Onomichi's best?
That statement doesn't hold water.

Maybe the Legends were good once...
But now Kanamizawa Gorgeous reigns supreme.
Who're you?

Ah, forgive me... My name is Tsubasa Kanamizawa,
heir and president of the Kanamizawa Group.

Th-The Kanamizawa Group is a major
corporation in these parts...!

I suppose even the uncultured peons of the
region heard of my company, then.

And, yes<symbol=em_dash_with_outline> We are an elite corporation
with annual revenues north of 60 billion.

Wow. And what could such a hotshot
CEO possibly want from us?

I don't like your tone, sir... You dare to mock
the captain of Onomichi's number one baseball team?

Number one team?
I thought that was the Legends...

Operative word, "was."
Right, Shige-san?
I-I suppose...

The thing is, I find baseball a charming affair,
so I put together my own little team.
And I named it... Kanamizawa Gorgeous...!
Kanamizawa Gorgeous...

Yes, and naturally I excel
at everything I do...

Which meant putting together a team
of overwhelming power and grace.

So I used my extensive financial clout to recruit
active professional players from across the globe.
[Hey! Come on, everyone!]
Who the hell are these guys...?

These are players I've scouted from
every professional league in the world.
Together, they are Kanamizawa Gorgeous.

A-Amazing... Rodriguez and Bowers...!
These guys are all top players!
Hmm... Is that so?

Thanks to their skill,
I had no trouble forming an unstoppable team.

And when I tested them against the Legends,
the so-called best Onomichi had to offer...

Our victory was astounding.
The Legends never stood a chance.

What? N-No way...
The Legends?

Yes, I'd heard they were all former professionals,
but they went down swinging, the dotards.

Truly... It was almost a letdown
to crush them like overripe fruit.
Mmm... That's disheartening...

It's hardly any fun playing unless the opponent
can provide some semblance of challenge...

So, Warriors...
We'd like you to play the role of that team.
...I'd take you down whether you asked or not.

Then it's decided... Our next game is for
the title of Onomichi's strongest team.

Oh! Right, there's a great idea
I'd been mulling around...
Great idea...?

I've actually been considering
acquiring this little hovel of a field...
Acquiring it?

Yes, I'd like to purchase this field to use
as my team's personal training ground.

What!? But if you did that,
there'd be nowhere else to play in Onomichi!

True... But it's not like anyone in Onomichi
stands a chance of beating us, correct?

What is the point of allowing teams
to play if they can never hope to win?

It would be put to better use by us,
so we can expand to Shikoku, Kyushu, and then nationals!

Wouldn't you agree it would be a
more worthy purpose for this sandlot?

Yeah, you've made yourself clear.
But you wanna get to the point?

If you guys defeat us...
I will abandon my pursuit.

But if you lose...
It moves forward as I've described.

Sound good? Don't the stakes make
for a more exciting game?
Just makes you an asshole.

Fine then! I'll give you a handicap.
You can challenge us as many times as you like.

If you can win before the field is mine,
I'll put a hard stop on my plans.

How's that? That should give you some
motivation to at least attempt to stop me.
